settings.currency_note: Xotelo has no PLN, so prices are fetched in EUR and converted with the NBP mid rate of the day.
settings.guests_note: 2 adults + 1 child aged 12 in one room. Prices are asked for 3 adults: the API returns nothing when a child age is given, and most Bangkok hotels charge a 12-year-old as an adult (extra bed or triple room). Booking links use 2 adults + child aged 12.
settings.match_note: Each hotel's Tripadvisor key is found by name in the city list: every word of match must be in the Tripadvisor name, no word of match_exclude. Set key to pin a hotel.

stays.name: First stay, after landing
stays.note: Flights leave 17-21 Jan and land the next day, so check-in is 18-22 Jan.

stays.name: Last stay, before flying home
stays.note: Check-out on the day of the flight home (3, 4 or 5 Feb). Night flights may need a late check-out.
